notes.title: [NEWS]English Language Support And Add Game Functions
notes.content:
[h2]Update[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add English interface and text.
You can set the language for the first time loading the game, or in the menu.
[*]Add small maps in some scenes.
You can investigate the activity of the map.
[*]Add easy and normal game modes.
Easy mode will make you not easy to die, you can set it at any time.
If you still feel the game is difficult, you can go to the store to upgrade weapons.
[/list]

If you have any questions, please let me know.
Gmail:mask80193@gmail.com
